description: This file defines the Proxy class within the GuzzleHttp library, providing static methods to create request handler proxies for synchronous and streaming requests.

classes.name: Proxy
classes.description: Provides methods to create proxy handlers for synchronous and streaming HTTP requests.

methods.name: wrapSync
methods.description: Creates a handler that directs synchronous requests to a specific handler and others elsewhere.

methods.name: wrapStreaming
methods.description: Creates a handler that directs streaming requests to a streaming-compatible handler and others elsewhere.
